label: marker panels
purpose: Diagnostic PCR marker panel cards for each candidate inversion regime. Reproduces the genome-based regime call (g0/g1/g2 from fish_regime_calls.tsv) using 3-10 markers per candidate. Activates when marker_panel_summary is present in state.data._layers_present.
activation_layer: marker_panel_summary (page renders empty-state with drag-in instructions until this is present)

panels.purpose: one card per candidate with regime counts, tier badge (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), expected accuracy, n markers, panel class, per-regime marker counts (g0/g1/g2 diagnostic), Tm range + multiplex spread, warning tags
(when marker_catalogue + marker_primers loaded) per-marker table: marker_id, position, variant_type, target_regime, specificity_score, freq_g0/g1/g2, family_spread_score, amplicon size, Tm fwd/rev
textual interpretation (which markers support which regime + combined-panel accuracy on calibration cohort)

primitives_used: unknown — page reads from state.data._layers_present and the marker_* layers directly
computed_preview_outputs: Tm range + multiplex spread classification (≤4°C = safe; otherwise tight)

documents.schema_doc_referenced_but_missing: SCHEMA §10 (marker layer column contracts) — referenced in module header; SCHEMA prose doc does not exist on disk

known_issues: SCHEMA §10 referenced in module header but the prose SCHEMA doc does not exist on disk (the 26 JSON schemas in registries/schemas/ cover layer formats but not the prose explanation).
